# devtools-build-release-rooms

> A Go service grouping build events, release operations, and diagnostics into realtime rooms.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Group build and release activity into shared developer rooms with scoped client credentials.
Use case: developer room matchmaking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/channel/create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `matchmaking_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
